answer: Every identity locks a bond in a public vault first. The vault posts a step schedule: the first 50 onboardings pay 40 tokens each; past that ridge the 51st pays 400. Each bond locks 20 epochs to one key, so one sum backs one identity only. Auditors send a whisper ping to 5% of identities each epoch; a missed reply in one hour, or a bond short of its slot, burns the bond. A rented-vault ring fails: the 51st rented vault still costs 400, and a locked vault cannot be re-rented. 1,000 fakes cost 50x40+950x400=382,000 locked; an honest user pays 40 once, reclaimed after 20 clean epochs.
